title: When the Orbit Turns
author: Ivo Montrose
blurb: Mara Nystrom, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
